matrix_coverage.resume_policy: Every selected invocation calls geoml.b2_a5; current provenance validation precedes any completed-result or scene-state reuse
notes: Logical work totals include verified reused state; no claim of recognition performance.
Skipped invocation slots are pending, not non-applicable samples.

interpretation.what_this_is: bounded execution evidence for replay parity, the receiver-consistent recomputation and the paired data flow
interpretation.checkpoints: Fresh fixed three-epoch CPU stand-ins on16 train observations; no A5 fitting; execution evidence only
interpretation.counterfactual_labels: agreement with the original label is descriptive; accuracy exists only for the stored original condition; alarm columns are rates among scenes whose ORIGINAL label is clean / not clean

execution_plan.scope: Reliability, evidence recovery and partial bounded pilot; no physical protocol or model-selection changes
execution_plan.incompatible_alternatives: Readiness artifacts/checkpoints fail P28 generator/training source identity; never relax the check

matrix.rationale: Cover every registered perturbation at least once, co/cross/both scopes, known and paired matched stages; unselected scopes remain pending without outcome-based expansion
matrix.completion_claim: PARTIAL even if all nine selected invocations succeed

command: Fresh fixed three-epoch CPU stand-ins on16 train observations; no A5 fitting; execution evidence only

full.skip_reason: this runner does not allow resetting the peak-RSS counter (/proc/self/clear_refs)
full.scope: Two summary-only source/test paths changed after launch; final affected regression below covers that delta; all detector/model/physical code unchanged

focused.scope: Intermediate snapshot; source/summary changed during run, not a final-file certificate

final_targeted.scope: Final state/matrix modules; summary-only guards changed during run and separately verified by final_summary

final_summary.scope: Final affected summary module, after last code/test change

focused.scope: read-only independent focused verification; real-physics replay module excluded to avoid a new RF generation run

final_focused.scope: Independent final focused verification after state, counterfactual naming, cross-parity note, matrix and summary fixes; RF replay module excluded; stand-in physics fixtures
final_focused.interpretation: Pytest passed. Hash guard correctly refused to certify the entire run as exact-final-files because the summary source and tests changed; the affected summary regressions were then run separately.

final_summary_affected.scope: Independent affected regression after the final summary-only coverage/status/totals changes; no real RF generation

postmerge_recovery.memory_semantics: RUSAGE_CHILDREN maximum process RSS including waited descendants; not simultaneous total RSS. Matrix /proc sampling saw only the driver, so sampled tree RSS does not certify child memory enforcement; raw per-invocation self RSS and waited-child peak are reported. All measured process peaks are below1572864KiB.
postmerge_recovery.concurrency: Local tests, fixture creation and pilot overlapped on the bounded CPU host; times are execution measurements, not isolated speed benchmarks.
postmerge_recovery.reproduction_note: Run the recorded fixture commands, then the matrix command with --plan first and without it next. Expect exit3/PARTIAL for the nine selected invocations. The pure summarizer recreates its core output; this postmerge evidence envelope adds the actual validation/command/checksum records.
postmerge_recovery.new_pr_ci: Exact final head evidence recorded in the new draft PR description after publication; historical PR15 CI is separate.
postmerge_recovery.independent_numerical_review: PASS: raw result/state/arrays/source/model checksums, experiment fingerprints, exact parity, pairing/denominators and confusion/transition sums; no independent replay/inference or bootstrap re-fit
